mode: Every documented Windows route executed from its own quickstart blocks on the owner hosts as a stranger meets them; the component bytes are v0.6.2's and the profiles and configuration are v0.6.3's, all carried by hash. What this release changes - and what this receipt accepts - is the documentation a reader executes and the bytes a clone yields.

rtx4090-native.first_install_run: run5 (stage-and-install 775 s including the 18 GB artifact from Hugging Face)
rtx4090-native.full_pass_run: run6 (rerun path, 484 s end to end)

rtx5090-windows-client.vision: the image acceptance described the release icon
rtx5090-windows-client.fail_closed: the outage request failed after stop-ninfer.sh

clean_host.note: RTX 4090: the shipped lineage root (12 releases) was uninstalled through Control-Release -Action Uninstall, the scheduled task removed, the external model kept; RTX 5090: the documented paths under the WSL2 home were removed and the owner's OMP configuration moved aside for the window

documented_blocks_verbatim.note: every executed step's bytes hashed to the documented block's SHA-256 recorded in the bundle manifest; the clone step alone was substituted with the candidate commit, recorded as such

execution_policy_faithful.note: the runner is launched as text without -ExecutionPolicy Bypass; the hosts' effective policy was Restricted, and the blocks' own Set-ExecutionPolicy lines carried them

public_urls_only.note: the native route downloaded the client archive, the five lane assets and the 18 GB model artifact from their public URLs and hashed each against the manifest; the container route pulled the image by digest

acceptance_turns.note: RTX 4090: tool turn read the marker exactly, nonce round-trip on --continue, outage request failed after -Action Stop; RTX 5090: the same plus Vision, outage request failed after stop-ninfer.sh

runtime_incumbent_restored.note: RTX 4090: the lane installed by the documented route serves (v0.6.1 release, 22,814 MiB, lease held, model at the documented ProgramData path), so the host now runs exactly what a reader would. RTX 5090: production serves again from its pinned image with its published port and restart policy, the lane supervisor's hold released, the owner's OMP configuration restored.
